data.title: 宝多六花 · 夏祭的捞水球
data.description: 浴衣祭典，她蹲在捞水球摊位前挽着袖子专注瞄准，额前碎发被夜风吹乱；捞起来之后高高举起给同伴看，笑容比平时明亮半个档位。
data.action: 收起浴衣袖子蹲在水池边，钩起条纹水球后举起展示。
data.lighting: warm festival lantern light reflected in the water-balloon basin
data.promptProse: Rikka Takarada crouches beside the festival water-balloon basin, gathering her indigo yukata sleeve while aiming the hook. After catching a striped balloon, she raises it toward her companion with an unusually bright smile, night wind moving her forehead strands. The medium three-quarter view keeps the basin rim and cream obi clear. Existing stall lanterns warm her cheek and sleeve, reflecting across the water and wet balloon below.
